about: e96 DOOR HEARTBEAT (feat/e96-door-heartbeat, coordinator ruling 2026-11-23): the member door's worker beats from its own counted steps (the translator's step budget, the door window's walks, the VM's bars) as each job starts and at least every 5 s while it works; the page treats a worker that owes an answer and has said nothing for 30 s as dead (refused by name in one sentence, terminated and replaced, every ask answered), never a slow worker that beats; and every 'checking' surface says for how long the check has run. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red. (e96 train, coordinator follow-up 2026-11-23) The silence bound starts only at the worker's first word; before it a separate, generous load bound (5 minutes) applies once per worker, and a worker that never speaks in it is stopped as a check that did not start, never as silent: L1-L5.
